newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy banks likely to follow central bank - ABI.
newsitem.headline: Italy banks likely to follow central bank - ABI.

text.p: Italian commercial banks are likely to follow the lead set by the Bank of Italy and cut interest rates by up to 0.75 of a percentage point, Italian Banking Association (ABI) chairman Tancredi Bianchi said on Wednesday.
He issued a statement welcoming the central bank's decision to cut its key discount rate to 7.50 percent from 8.25 percent, effective Thursday.

"The conditions are in place for a similar fall in bank rates," Bianchi said. He said the Bank of Italy move confirmed that inflation was falling and also that monetary variables were under firm control.
The head of the industrial employers' organisation Confindustria, Giorgio Fossa, earlier called on banks to lower their own rates by a full 75 basis points.
